#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;

    bool inside = false;
    int countInside = 0, maxOutside = 0, currentLen = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, currentLen);
            currentLen = 0;
            inside = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (currentLen > 0) {
                countInside++;
                currentLen = 0;
            }
        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (inside && currentLen > 0) {
                countInside++;
            } else if (!inside) {
                maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, currentLen);
            }
            currentLen = 0;
        } else {
            currentLen++;
        }
    }
    maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, currentLen);
    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << countInside << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
